alias.title: “{{skill}}” is the same as…
alias.description: Pick the skill in your profile that means the same. It's saved as a synonym and the fit of your jobs is recalculated.
alias.none: No skill in your profile matches.

row.gone: No job in the period asks for it any more

noProfile.title: You don't have a profile yet
noProfile.body: Gaps are worked out against your profile. Create it in “My profile” or ask your agent.

title: Skills to build
intro: What your jobs ask for that isn't in your profile yet. Mark each skill as yours, as a synonym of one in your profile or for your training plan.
addHave: Add the ones I have to my profile ({{count}})

covered.title: Your profile covers what your jobs ask for
covered.body: Everything {{jobs}} jobs ask for is in your profile (open, and approved or sent in the last {{days}} days).

summary: {{count}} skills asked for by {{jobs}} jobs from the last {{days}} days that aren't in your profile yet.
weightHint: How much it counts in your jobs: 1 for each job that requires it and 0.5 if it's nice-to-have, times the job's fit.
periodHint: Counts the open jobs and the ones you approved or sent in that period. Fewer days show what is asked for now; more show what keeps coming up across your search.
